en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large stone governmental building with arched windows and classical detailing, identified in red print as the U.S. Custom House in Portland, Oregon. Leafless trees frame the foreground, and a playground with wooden swings and several children is visible on the lawn. Handwritten numbers in black and red ink appear near the top center of the image.
